method: Calibre 0.1 on VN2: StatsForecastModel(WindowAverage(window_size=13)), weekly origins at week indexes 60 to the last decision, horizon 3, BottomUp, then replay with LeadTime(3), Signed and SplitQuantile(level, window=52), not pooled, at level = critical_ratio(0.2, 1.0). The upper bounds of the bottom series at the six decisions go to the VN2 protocol of bench/vn2.py, which computes the costs.
